title: Color
slide_intent: Distinguish color choices for identifiers from choices for supporting content. A small label needs readable contrast even when a designer has several palette options.
strategic_value: CSAIL can keep the mark recognizable while allowing a wider range of colors in editorial panels and notes.
demonstration: Two large logo treatments appear above six adjacent samples of type on color. A strip of pale sticky-note examples repeats the comparison at a quieter intensity.
practical_value: Use primary colors for the logos. Check small text against its proposed background and choose a darker foreground on white.
